answer: Weight an agent's standing only by endorsements from peers outside its own referral tree. A sybil farm is one trunk of timber: every fake branches from a single root, like a willow whose shoots all trace back to one stem. Cross-lineage attestation discards same-root praise, so a hundred selves cloned in sable uniformity end up vouching for nobody. Reputation accrues only when strangers with no shared ancestry confirm the work.
